title: The Raja Saab
plot_overview: A young man searching for his lost grandfather enters a haunted mansion and awakens a powerful family curse. As supernatural forces emerge, his life is disrupted and reality itself is placed at risk, forcing him to confront a mystery tied to his family and the mansion.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy it for its haunted-mansion premise, supernatural chaos, and star-driven spectacle; Not for you if you prefer consistent horror, focused storytelling, or polished effects.
review_summary: Pros: strong opening; occasional visual appeal; lead presence | Cons: messy story; weak horror-comedy balance; uneven pacing
